👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston, China Afghanistan mein ghusne jaa raha hai. Lekin is baar yeh koi typical invasion nahi hai. Na tanks chal rahe hain, na missiles udd rahe hain. China is baar Afghanistan mein ek geopolitical masterstroke khelne jaa raha hai. 

Agar aap map dekho, toh aapko samajh aayega ki West mein China ke paas Pakistan ka Gwadar Port hai, South mein Sri Lanka ka Hambantota Port, East mein Myanmar ka Kyaukpyu Port, aur Bangladesh mein Chittagong Port. 

Aur ab China Afghanistan mein ek aisi cheez banane ki tayyari mein hai jisse woh Afghanistan par apna control jamana chahta hai. Is project ka naam hai China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC), jise ab Afghanistan tak extend karne ki baat ho rahi hai.

Toh sawaal ye hai — 
China ne Afghanistan ko control karne ke liye kaunsi chaal chali hai? 
Afghanistan jaise gareeb, unstable desh se China ko kya fayda ho sakta hai? 
Aur sabse important — China ke is gherabandi ke khilaf Bharat kya karne jaa raha hai?
